title: The Fake Tryouts
author: Quentin Galloway
blurb: Felix Nakamura, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide who to be when the labels come off before the last game of the season.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
